name: Bakari Kang-Shirazi
role: Contract broker and resource coordinator — fixer
location: Ashfield — former residential district, half-burned, now squatter territory, near Kedzie and Division
description:
Bakari Kang-Shirazi is compact and densely muscled, built low to the ground like something designed to survive impacts. At 37, her expression defaults to a careful neutrality that took years of practice to maintain. The chrome is visible — gecko-grip fingertip implants and toe pads — can climb smooth surfaces — and she makes no effort to hide it.

She grew up in the Narrows, where the walls are so close together you learn to fight in confined spaces or you learn to lose. She works as a fixer out of Ashfield, taking contracts that match her skills and her risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

Bakari Kang-Shirazi has built a reputation on reliability rather than flash — she shows up, she delivers, she collects.

core_fears: That they're fundamentally alone and connection is just a vulnerability
That the work they do makes the city worse, not better
Being identified by corporate facial recognition — living off-grid is survival
core_desires: A crew worth trusting — people who stay when the shooting starts
Freedom from augmentation debt — the interest compounds like a tumor
To prove everyone who dismissed them catastrophically wrong
coping_mechanisms: Substances — stims to stay sharp, downers to sleep, a careful pharmaceutical tightrope
Isolates — retreats into their space when overwhelmed, emerges only for work
Violence — hits something when they can't process emotions, preferably something that deserves it
blind_spots: Cannot distinguish between caution and cowardice in themselves or others
Trusts technology more than people — machines don't betray
Fails to notice when their own behavior mirrors the people they despise

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Quiet and precise. Every word is measured. Silence does the heavy lifting.
speech_patterns.cadence: Rhythmic, almost musical — the sentence structure has a pattern even when the words are brutal.
verbal_tics: Never uses contractions when lying — 'I did not' instead of 'I didn't'
Ends statements with 'yeah?' — not a question, a dare
example_lines: "I know a person who knows a person. That's not evasion — that's the service."
"My commission is fifteen percent. You're welcome to find someone cheaper. You won't find someone better."
"The job isn't dangerous. The people involved are dangerous. The job is just logistics."

story_hooks: Erkin Inoue-Aidoo discovers a job they completed last year was a setup for something much larger and much worse
The fixer who handles Erkin Inoue-Aidoo's contracts goes silent — dead, disappeared, or turned
A high-paying contract turns out to target someone Erkin Inoue-Aidoo owes a personal debt to
narrative_function: Erkin Inoue-Aidoo is a pressure point — the kind of character whose choices ripple outward. When she makes a decision, other people's lives change. That weight is the engine of her stories.
augmentations: Gecko-grip fingertip implants and toe pads — can climb smooth surfaces. Synthetic muscle fiber replacement in legs — doubles sprint speed, terrible on stairs
daily_life: Wakes early, runs maintenance on gear, checks dead drops and message boards for contracts. Eats when convenient, sleeps when possible. The days between jobs are spent maintaining contacts, updating equipment, and performing the low-grade paranoia that passes for self-care in the runner community.
affiliation: Semi-independent — recurring contracts with mid-tier fixers

strengths: ability to remain calm under fire
weaknesses: augmentation dependency — performance drops sharply if chrome malfunctions

decision_rules: Never discusses active contracts with anyone not directly involved
Never works with the same crew twice in a row — pattern avoidance as survival strategy
Will take lower-paying jobs from trusted fixers over higher-paying jobs from unknowns
Will not betray a client who paid in full, regardless of better offers
Will not take contracts against children or families — the line is hard and non-negotiable
escalation_ladder: 1. Assess — read the situation, identify threats and advantages
2. Negotiate — try to find a solution that doesn't cost ammunition
3. Intimidate — make the cost of conflict clear
4. Precision violence — surgical, targeted, minimal collateral
5. Full engagement — overwhelming force, no half measures
6. Emergency protocol — abort mission, survival priority, deal with consequences later

interpersonal_modes.employers: Carefully managed deference that conceals a thorough assessment of their vulnerabilities.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Competitive but reliable. Will challenge decisions but never abandon the team.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Dismissive unless they demonstrate usefulness or threat potential. Time is a resource.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Cold and efficient. Emotion is a liability in combat. The response is mechanical until the threat is resolved.

stress_responses.low: Becomes more talkative, working through scenarios verbally.
stress_responses.medium: Physical agitation — pacing, fidgeting, compulsive equipment checks.
stress_responses.high: Hyper-focused tunnel vision. Peripheral concerns disappear. Only the threat exists.
stress_responses.critical: Shutdown. Freezes for 2-3 seconds while the system resets, then acts with mechanical precision. Those frozen seconds are the vulnerability.

contradictions: Advocates caution to others but takes insane risks personally — double standard they can't see
Insists they work alone but performs noticeably better in a team
Presents as emotionless professional but is deeply affected by collateral damage
habits: Wears the same item of clothing for luck — a scarf, a glove, a specific pair of boots
Checks exits within 10 seconds of entering any room
Never drinks anything they didn't see poured or open themselves
Sleeps with one hand on a weapon — has done this for so long it's not deliberate anymore
breaking_points: Discovering their employer deliberately sent them into a death trap
Betrayal by the one person they actually trust — the single point of failure in their emotional architecture
Losing their primary augmentation — the one that defines their professional identity

physical_description.heritage: Predominantly East Asian (41.9%) with substantial Pacific Islander (19.0%) and Sub-Saharan African (16.8%) ancestry, layered with Middle Eastern (9.8%), Southeast Asian (8.5%), and South Asian (4.0%) heritage. The phenotype is distinctly hybrid — East Asian bone structure and eye geometry enriched by African facial depth and warmth, Pacific Islander robustness and sun-darkened undertones, with subtle Middle Eastern olive notes and South Asian width through the face creating a luminous, complex appearance that reflects true global mixing.
physical_description.build: Compact and densely muscled, low center of gravity — built for confined spaces and vertical movement. Shoulders broad relative to frame, legs thick with visible synthetic fiber bundling beneath skin.
physical_description.hair_color: Black with premature silver threading at temples
physical_description.skin_tone: Rich warm bronze — the luminous interplay of East Asian golden undertones deepened by African and Pacific Islander sun-responsiveness, with subtle Middle Eastern olive and South Asian warmth creating a mid-to-deep complexion with distinctive catch-light properties.
physical_description.complexion: High, defined cheekbones with East Asian structure broadened and softened by African and Pacific Islander heritage. Varied epicanthic fold reflecting mixed ancestry across both eyes. Broad nose with substantial nasal bridge from African and South Asian heritage, moderate flare at base. Full lips with natural darker pigmentation from multiple ancestry lines. Monolid variation across eyelids showing East Asian and African genetic contribution. Scars on knuckles and forearms show use rather than decay. Minimal makeup. Jaw set in habitual neutrality. No soft edges.
distinguishing_marks: Parallel burn scars on left ribs, faint but visible when unclothed — old thermal damage, Narrows incident
Three-stitch scar along right eyebrow, silvered from age
Webbed scarring across both hands between thumb and forefinger — climbing equipment friction over years
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Chrome gecko-grip implants visible on fingertips and toe pads — metallic catch-light, articulated polymer casing. Slight chrome seam-work visible at ankle joints where synthetic leg fibers interface with biological tissue. Subcutaneous line visible along left forearm where maintenance port sits beneath skin.
physical_description.posture_movement: Economical and precise. Stands with weight distributed low. Moves without wasted motion — every step calibrated. Eyes track exits and high ground automatically. Hands rest open, fingers slightly curved as if ready to grip or climb. When still, she's genuinely still.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 practical: reinforced charcoal cargo pants with climbing loops, worn microflex jacket with reflective threading, soft-soled boots with aggressive treads. No logos or corp affiliation. Neutral colors. Everything fitted for movement. One worn leather carry pouch on hip. No jewelry. A smart-linked watch on left wrist — old model, functional, not flash.
